title: 第19章 刘小燕第20章 丰满的王翠
content_zh:
;;
“你敢……”
庞局长指着陈楚。
“信不信我让你牢底坐穿！”
“呵！”陈楚冷哼一声。
“我先让你坐穿！”
用力往下一扔。
“啊……”庞局长痛苦嚎叫。
两条腿仿佛断了一样。
他面部扭曲，冷汗不止。
“我再问你一遍！刘小燕呢！”
“我带你去……”
陈楚把两人拎着，像是拎两只小鸡一样，出了门。
不少治安员冲了出来。
“快放下我们局长！要不然……”
陈楚手掌握紧。
庞局长痛苦的惨叫。
“不要靠近，快让开……”
三人上了车。
女治安员开车。

陈楚掐住庞局长手腕，用力一捏。
“啊……”手腕完全骨折。
疼的他像是死猪一样嚎叫。
女治安员提醒道：“陈先生，你这么对我们局长，难道就不怕……”
“老实开你的车！”
陈楚一嘴巴抽过去，女治安员另外一边脸也肿了起来。
女治安员哭哭啼啼的开着车。
陈楚根本不惯着她毛病，这种人，不值得可怜。
“给那两个王八蛋打电话！快点！”
“好好，我这就打。”
不过电话掏出来，他的手骨折，已经拿不住了。
陈楚把电话拨出，按在他脑袋上。
“喂，大侄子啊……”
那边传来范惠明和马子涵潇洒的声音。
“庞叔叔，您有事儿啊？”
“是的，大侄子，你们现在哪里啊？”
“庞叔叔，我爸爸不是给你打过去十万了吗？难道还搞不定陈楚那个乡巴佬啊？”
范惠明很随便的说了一句，看来这种事不是第一次干了。
一旁的马子涵戏谑：“庞叔，我们正在爽呢，要不然你也来啊？”
陈楚点了点头。

庞局长嗯嗯道：“算我一个，发个定位。”
“好嘞！”
很快，发了个定位。
content_en:
;;
"How dare you..."
Director Pang pointed at Chen Chu.
"Believe it or not, I will put you in jail!"
"Ha!" Chen Chu snorted coldly.
"I'll let you sit through it first!"
Throw it down hard.
"Ah..." Director Pang howled in pain.
Both legs seemed broken.
His face was distorted and he was sweating.
"I'll ask you again! Where is Liu Xiaoyan!"
"I'll take you there..."
Chen Chu carried the two of them out of the door like they were carrying two chickens.
Many security guards rushed out.
"Hurry up and put down our director! Otherwise..."
Chen Chu tightened his grip.
Director Pang screamed in pain.
"Don't come close, get out of the way..."
The three of them got into the car.
The female security officer drives.
Chen Chu grabbed Director Pang's wrist and squeezed it hard.
"Ah..." The wrist was completely broken.
He howled like a dead pig in pain.
The female security guard reminded: "Mr. Chen, aren't you afraid that you will treat our director like this..."
"Drive your car honestly!"
Chen Chu slapped his mouth, and the other side of the female security guard's face swelled up.
The female security guard was crying and driving.
Chen Chu is not used to her faults at all. This kind of person is not worthy of pity.
"Call those two bastards! Hurry!"
"Okay, I'll fight now."
But when he took out the phone, his hand was broken and he couldn't hold it anymore.
Chen Chu dialed the phone and pressed it on his head.
"Hey, eldest nephew..."
The cool voices of Fan Huiming and Ma Zihan came from over there.
"Uncle Pang, are you okay?"
"Yes, eldest nephew, where are you now?"
"Uncle Pang, didn't my father give you a hundred thousand? Can't you still deal with that country bumpkin Chen Chu?"
Fan Huiming said casually, it seemed that this was not the first time he had done this.
Ma Zihan on the side joked: "Uncle Pang, we are having fun, how about you come too?"
Chen Chu nodded.
Director Pang hummed and said, "Count me in and send me your location."
"Okay!"
Soon, a location was sent.
